The empty-file case failed because the record area started as spaces. In GnuCOBOL the FD record buffer starts as NUL bytes. With an empty file, the first READ hits end of file and leaves the record unchanged. `FUNCTION TRIM` removes only spaces, so the NULs are displayed. The fix is to initialise the record to NUL bytes.

```python
from cobol_equiv.runtime import Storage, Alnum, Num
from cobol_equiv.runtime.files import LineSequentialReader


def main(stdin: bytes, input_files: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    out = bytearray()
    rec = Storage("FD", [Alnum("INPUT-RECORD", "X(256)")])
    record = rec["INPUT-RECORD"]
    record.set_raw(b"\x00" * 256)

    if "input.txt" not in input_files:
        out += b"The file could not be opened.\n"
        return bytes(out), {}

    reader = LineSequentialReader(input_files["input.txt"], 256)
    line_count = 1
    eof = False
    while not eof:
        data = reader.read(record)
        if data is None:
            eof = True
        lc = line_count % 1000000
        text = record.raw.strip(b" ")
        out += b"%06d" % lc + b": " + text + b"\n"
        line_count += 1

    return bytes(out), {}
```
